checks.description: HARD RULE (auto-fail if violated): nothing in any shipped file offers, sells, prices, or implies paid airplay — no submission fees, no per-submission credits, no paid adds, no guaranteed airplay, no payola-adjacent mechanics. Spins are opt-in and logged transparently. The pack's no_paid_placement flag must be true.

Every track carries at least one verified_fact, and every verified_fact has a fact, a live citation URL, an observation date, and a confidence label. Citations are mandatory — nothing ships without one. No bpm/key/duration/isrc invented: those fields are not in the schema and must not appear in the pack.
DEFAULT_CONFIG + optional config.json override flow works: a config.json with orgName/productName/colors overrides the CWI defaults and produces a branded build with no unreplaced tokens.

EQUIP / CONFIGURE / SPIN steps are copy-paste operable: every URL referenced (pack, schema, spins schema, item card, page, hub device, contact) is live, the ?pack=<id> param is documented, and the SPIN block is a valid spins-ledger entry.
The official CWI logo is present on every shipped visual asset. Brand rule: the logo ships on everything.

evidence.brand-token-discipline: index.html header logo, announce.html header logo — logo.jpg on both visual assets
evidence.give-block-operability: give-block.md EQUIP/CONFIGURE/SPIN reference pack, schema, spins schema, item-card, page, dial hub, ?pack param, hp@cumulativeweb.com — all live per gate 2
evidence.no-paid-placement: pack no_paid_placement=true; affirmative paid-placement phrase scan across all 8 shipped files returns zero hits; hard gate enforced in test.py gate 4
evidence.verified-fact-citations: 24/24 launch tracks carry >=1 verified_fact with citation+observed+confidence in automated gate 1; schema forbids invented bpm/key/duration/isrc via additionalProperties:false
evidence.white-label-config: gate 4 builds a temp config.json override (orgName/productName/colors) through build.py and confirms the overrides land in index.html with no leftover tokens

self_evaluation.run: automated: open-wave/test.py gate 4 evaluates the product against this rubric
